notes.title: October 2020 Hotfix Update
notes.content: Addresses a number of issues with Multiplayer functionality in the game.

notes.title: General Patch Update
notes.content:
We have resolved several issues that arose after the online multiplayer update.

Addressed low terrain visibility issues
Fixed potential crashes that occurred while loading into maps, including Naboo and Geonosis

notes.title: Online Multiplayer Update
notes.content:
Online multiplayer on Steam has been added to the game.  We also made the following changes to the game:
French, Italian, German, Spanish language support added
Additional audio support added
Addressed a number of menu and gameplay issues for a number of different screen sizes

notes.title: Hotfix Update 1
notes.content:
Minor bug fixes and optimized performance, the most important fixes are:

[list]
[*] Framerate capped at 60FPS, which will address the Crouch & Vehicle Flipping issues in the game that were noticed by players with high framerate monitors.
[*] Fixed a number of the on/off video settings in setup not being able to be toggled.
[*] Fixed incorrect aspect ratio in the 3d game world for widescreen monitors. 
[/list]
